$comment: Configuration for scripts/ui-check.mjs. It is data, not policy.
The policy lives in the gate. This file lists the facts only this
repository knows: where the source is, which imports are allowed, and
which violations are documented exceptions with an owner and an expiry.
An exception suppresses exactly one file and one code. There is no

exceptions.why: next/og ImageResponse paints a bitmap once at build time. There is no cascade and no data-pack in a bitmap, so inline styles and literal colours are the og renderer's only interface, and the literals mirror the dark cyan theme tokens. The raw draws a data-URI mark the renderer cannot resolve any other way.
